result.title: Scout-Refine-Correct: Teaching Flow Models to Refine Their Own Samples
result.summary: The quality of image generation models trained with diffusion or flow matching is largely fixed by the training budget: at inference, the only available lever is the number of sampling steps, and additional steps improve quality only up to a point. We present a training recipe, Scout-Refine-Correct (SRC), that instead gives a flow-matching generator a genuine inference-time refinement capability. At each sampling step the model takes a scout rollout -- $K$ steps ahead along its own trajectory -- extrapolates a full-sample estimate, and feeds that estimate back to itself as a self-conditioning signal before taking the real step. This can be repeated for $R$ refinement rounds. Two correction losses, applied during training at states the model's own rollouts actually reach rather than only on the ground-truth path, teach the model to use this signal to reach new samples instead of collapsing to a suboptimal one. On ImageNet-256, SRC improves LightningDiT-B from FID~14.5 to FID~7.26 at NFE~550, matching a privileged best-of-$N$ baseline that uses an oracle FID verifier to choose among samples. SRC uses no external verifier, no reward signal, and, after ablation, almost no extra parameters over the base architecture. Combining SRC with best-of-$N$ improves the result further, to FID~3.81 at NFE~4400, showing that the two axes are complementary. We ablate the main design choices -- the architectural pathway for the scout signal, the scout horizon, each correction loss, and the training schedule to demonstrate key working components of training.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Scout-Refine-Correct 训练配方：让 flow-matching 生成器在采样时先行 K 步得到 scout 轨迹并外推整样本估计，作为自条件信号反馈，可重复多轮精修，并用两个 correction loss 在自身 rollout 实际到达的状态上训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「在自身轨迹到达的状态上训练 + 无外部验证器的多轮自我修正」思路，可能为 LVR 的轨迹监督、迭代 latent 状态精修与停止决策提供可核查线索，但属图像生成任务，与视觉推理的答案使用尚无直接联系。
